router_body:
name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED plan-test linux corpus tier'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.plan-test:
needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'plan-test')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python3 ci/tiers-test.py
ci.yml.linux:
name: linux x86-64 (every gate)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'linux')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # 60, not 20: a toolchain pin misses the cache (its key hashes
    # wolf-toolchain.toml), and the cold build downloads the 120 pinned
    # packages one by one; twice that alone outlasted 20 minutes (clef#14).
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            .wolf-bin
            target/container
          key: clef-linux-${{ hashFiles('wolf-toolchain.toml', 'ci/oracle-lock.json') }}
      - name: census, oracle, proof, writer, and refusal gates
        env:
          CLEF_ENGINE: docker
        run: tools/in-container tools/gate
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: linux-evidence
          path: target/evidence
ci.yml.corpus:
name: exhaustive census second-opinion corpus
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'corpus')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target/container
          key: clef-oracle-${{ hashFiles('ci/oracle-lock.json') }}
      - env:
          CLEF_ENGINE: docker
        run: tools/in-container tools/corpus --check
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: corpus-evidence
          path: target/corpus
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tier || 'unplanned' }}
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs:
      - plan
      - plan-test
      - linux
      - corpus
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 ci/tiers.py verdict
